components.name: Dual Ingestion Engine
components.description: Cross-platform network packet and active socket capturing. Includes Engine A (zero-driver psutil connection inspector) and Engine B (Scapy deep kernel packet sniffer).

components.name: Rule & Detection Engine
components.description: Evaluates network events against sliding-window buffers, thresholds, and YAML signatures. Classifies threats and tags MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

components.name: Suricata & ET Open Importer
components.description: Streams category rulesets from rules.emergingthreats.net (50,000+ rules), parses Suricata/Snort syntax, and converts signatures into native YAML.

components.name: Persistence & SIEM Streaming Layer
components.description: Multi-tier storage. Stores real-time metrics in SQLite (ids_storage.db), streams Suricata EVE JSON (logs/eve.json) for Wazuh/Splunk, and writes Snort Fast Log (logs/fast.log).

components.name: Firewall IPS & Threat Intelligence
components.description: Active IPS enforcement via OS firewall (netsh advfirewall), blacklist management, and external threat reputation lookups (AbuseIPDB/Feodo).

components.name: FastAPI Gateway & Runtime Core
components.description: REST API gateway, background capture orchestrator, CORS handler, and static SPA web server for the dashboard.

components.name: Glassmorphic SOC Dashboard
components.description: Bilingual (VI/EN) single-page application built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Provides real-time threat radar, rule management, and manual IP blocking.

components.name: Adversary Attack Simulator
components.description: Automated attack simulation suite generating port scans, SSH/RDP brute force, DoS floods, and DNS exfiltration for instant verification.
